hero.name: Leo
hero.headline: I build across web, games, and AI.
hero.subhead: This is a working record of what I've built: web apps, small games, and projects exploring AI prompting. Course work, personal builds, and things I made to learn something specific.

about.heading: I like picking something I don't know yet and building with it.
about.bio: I'm Leo. My background is in IT, and I split my project time across three areas: web development, game development, and AI prompting. I don't specialize in just one because each one teaches me something the others don't: web work is about structure and users, game dev is about feel and logic, and prompting is about being precise with language to get a reliable result.
focusAreas: Web development: React and Node projects, from small tools to full sites
Game development: browser and desktop games built in Unity and Godot
AI prompting: structured prompts, evaluation, and small AI-assisted tools
Documentation: every project here includes notes on what I'd change next

skills.intro: What I reach for most often, organized by discipline.

work.heading: Projects
work.intro: A mix of web apps, games, and AI experiments. Project file placeholders are marked below, swap them for your own repo links or downloads.

projects.name: Fieldnote
projects.description: A booking flow for outdoor guides, built to test how far a checkout process can be simplified without losing information the guide actually needs.

projects.name: Pallet
projects.description: A scheduling dashboard built to replace a shared spreadsheet, with role-based views and a simple conflict warning when two bookings overlap.

projects.name: Signal Drift
projects.description: A short puzzle game about routing power through a broken grid. Built to practice level design and a save system that doesn't break on partial progress.

projects.name: Hollow Freight
projects.description: A top-down movement and inventory prototype built in Godot, mainly to learn its scene system and compare it against Unity for a small project.

projects.name: Brief Compiler
projects.description: A structured prompt chain that turns a messy project brief into a scoped task list, built to test how much structure a prompt needs before output quality stops improving.

projects.name: Support Triage
projects.description: A set of prompts and test cases for sorting support tickets by urgency, along with notes on where the model got it wrong and how the prompt was adjusted.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: This policy explains what information is collected through this site and how it is used. This site is operated by Leo, referred to here as "I" or "me."

sections.heading: Information I collect
sections.body: When you submit the contact form, I collect the name, email address, and message you enter. Standard hosting logs may record your IP address and browser type for security and diagnostic purposes.

sections.heading: How I use it
sections.body: Information submitted through the contact form is used only to reply to your message. I do not sell or rent your information to third parties.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. If analytics are added in the future, this policy will be updated to describe what is collected and why.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: Contact form submissions may pass through a third-party email delivery service in order to reach my inbox. That service processes the data only to deliver the message and does not use it for its own purposes.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Inquiry details are kept only as long as needed to respond to your message.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask me to show you, correct, or delete the information I hold about you by emailing hello@leo.dev.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
